# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.ts from commander's help output. Do not edit by hand:
     run `pnpm exec tsx scripts/gen-cli-docs.ts` after changing apps/cli/src/program.ts. -->

Every command talks to the local daemon (`beamhop daemon`) over its localhost API, using the token in
`$BEAMHOP_HOME/api-token`. Add `--json` before the command for machine-readable output, for example
`beamhop --json agent ls`. Environment: `BEAMHOP_HOME` (default `~/.beamhop`), `BEAMHOP_PORT`
(default 7878), `BEAMHOP_URL` and `BEAMHOP_TOKEN` to target another daemon.

```text
Usage: beamhop [options] [command]

Join your AI agent harnesses to Nostr, Telegram, Slack and Discord — sandboxed.

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  --json                           machine-readable JSON output
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                   first-run setup: doctor, harnesses, owner key, phone, first
                                   agent, hello
  status                           daemon, agents and approvals at a glance
  doctor [options] [checkIds...]   check sandbox prerequisites, harnesses and channels; --fix
                                   repairs what it can
  panic [options]                  EMERGENCY STOP: kill all sessions, pause schedules, disconnect
                                   channels (incl. cloud agents)
  resume                           resume after panic
  daemon [options]                 run the beamhop daemon in the foreground
  ui                               print the URL of the local web UI (contains your access token —
                                   do not share)
  agent                            manage agents
  harness                          discover and manage agent harnesses
  channel                          connect messaging channels
  join [options] <agent> <target>  make an agent join a channel target, e.g. `beamhop join myagent
                                   mybot:group/-100123 --role viewer`
  leave <agent> <target>           remove an agent from a channel target it joined
  session                          agent sessions
  approvals [options]              list pending approvals
  approve [options] <id>           allow a pending approval (ids from `beamhop approvals`)
  deny <id>                        deny a pending approval
  role                             roles and grants
  link <person> <principal>        link a channel account to a person, e.g. `beamhop link alice
                                   telegram:5551`
  owner                            manage owners (multiple owners supported)
  policy                           sandbox policy
  secret                           secrets (in an encrypted vault file; values are never shown)
  schedule                         scheduled and event-driven prompts
  deploy                           run agents in the cloud (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Fly.io, Render,
                                   Railway)
  alerts                           alert thresholds (budget, security spikes, offline agents)
  audit [options]                  every decision, violation and config change, newest first
  usage [options]                  tokens and spend per agent
  device                           paired devices (phones, browsers)
  identity                         Nostr identities and NIP-05
  data                             export or purge transcripts and audit data
  help [command]                   display help for command
```

## beamhop init

```text
Usage: beamhop init [options]

first-run setup: doctor, harnesses, owner key, phone, first agent, hello

Options:
  -y, --yes                  no questions: accept defaults (pairing and the hello test only with
                             --pair / --hello)
  --owner-npub <npub>        use your existing Nostr key; the daemon keeps only the npub
  --export-nsec              show the new owner nsec once (backup)
  --no-doctor                skip the doctor step
  --no-harnesses             skip harness discovery
  --no-identity              skip the owner identity step
  --pair                     pair a phone (QR code)
  --no-pair                  skip phone pairing
  --no-agent                 skip creating the first agent
  --hello                    send the hello DM and wait for your reply
  --no-hello                 skip the hello round trip
  --agent-name <name>        first agent name
  --harness <id>             harness for the first agent
  --preset <id>              agent preset (personal-assistant, code-reviewer, team-dev-bot,
                             public-qa)
  --mount <path[:ro|rw]>     folder the first agent may use (same form as `agent add --mount`)
  --mount-mode <mode>        folder access (choices: "ro", "rw")
  --sandbox <profile>        sandbox profile for the first agent (choices: "strict", "workspace")
  --device-name <name>       name for the paired phone
  --pair-timeout <seconds>   how long to wait for the phone
  --hello-timeout <seconds>  how long to wait for your reply
  -h, --help                 display help for command
```

## beamhop doctor

```text
Usage: beamhop doctor [options] [checkIds...]

check sandbox prerequisites, harnesses and channels; --fix repairs what it can

Options:
  --fix       apply the fixes beamhop knows: every failing check, or only the given check ids
  -y, --yes   with --fix: run fixes that need administrator rights (sudo) without asking
  --verbose   with --fix: show the output of every fix
  -h, --help  display help for command
```


## beamhop agent

```text
Usage: beamhop agent [options] [command]

manage agents

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  ls|list                    list agents with status, sessions and spend today
  show <name>                show an agent's full config, status and npub (JSON)
  add [options] <name>       create an agent
  rm <name>                  delete an agent and its config
  start <name>               start (or re-enable) an agent
  stop [options] <name>      stop an agent; running sessions finish unless --hard
  clone <name> <newName>     copy an agent under a new name (new Nostr key)
  presets                    list the built-in presets for `agent add --preset`
  set <name> <key=value...>  patch agent config, e.g. `beamhop agent set bot model=gpt-5
                             budgets.dailyUsd=3`
  help [command]             display help for command
```

## beamhop harness

```text
Usage: beamhop harness [options] [command]

discover and manage agent harnesses

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  scan                    look for installed harnesses
  ls|list                 list known harnesses and their status (from the last scan)
  status [options] [id]   login status of harnesses for sandboxed agents; --check verifies it for
                          real
  login [options] <id>    log a harness in for sandboxed agents; reads the key or token from stdin,
                          --from-env, or --from gh; --browser runs the harness's own sign-in
  install [options] <id>  install a harness on this computer (its own installer, Homebrew, npm or
                          winget)
  update [options] <id>   update an installed harness the way it was installed
  updates [options]       installed harnesses with a newer version (checked once a day; --refresh
                          checks now)
  jobs                    running and recent (last hour) installs, updates and logins
  job [options] <jobId>   follow an install, update or login (also one started in the app); --cancel
                          stops it
  logout [options] <id>   remove a harness login (other harnesses using the same key lose it too)
  add [options] <id>      register any ACP-speaking agent, e.g. `beamhop harness add myagent --acp
                          "my-agent --acp"`
  help [command]          display help for command
```

### beamhop harness scan

```text
Usage: beamhop harness scan [options]

look for installed harnesses

  -h, --help  display help for command
```

```text
list known harnesses and their status (from the last scan)
```

### beamhop harness status

```text
Usage: beamhop harness status [options] [id]

login status of harnesses for sandboxed agents; --check verifies it for real

Options:
  --check     verify the stored login (provider key endpoint, or start the harness in the sandbox)
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop harness login

```text
Usage: beamhop harness login [options] <id>

log a harness in for sandboxed agents; reads the key or token from stdin, --from-env, or --from gh;
--browser runs the harness's own sign-in

Options:
  --method <method>  which login method (default: the first; see `beamhop harness status <id>`)
  --from-env <var>   read the value from this environment variable
  --from <tool>      import it from another tool: gh (`gh auth token`)
  --browser          run the harness's own sign-in (browser or device code) instead of storing a key
  --no-open          with --browser: do not open a browser here; print the page (and code) to open
                     on any device
  --verbose          with --browser: show the login command's output
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

### beamhop harness install

```text
Usage: beamhop harness install [options] <id>

install a harness on this computer (its own installer, Homebrew, npm or winget)

Options:
  --method <method>  how to install (default: the best one for this computer) (choices: "native",
                     "brew", "npm", "winget")
  --no-follow        start the install and return; follow it later with `beamhop harness job
                     <jobId>`
  --verbose          show the installer's output
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

### beamhop harness update

```text
Usage: beamhop harness update [options] <id>

update an installed harness the way it was installed

Options:
  --no-follow  start the update and return; follow it later with `beamhop harness job <jobId>`
  --verbose    show the installer's output
  -h, --help   display help for command
```

## beamhop channel

```text
Usage: beamhop channel [options] [command]

connect messaging channels

Options:
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  providers                 list channel providers you can add
  ls|list                   list channels and their connection status
  add [options] <provider>  add a channel non-interactively, e.g. `beamhop channel add telegram
                            --name mybot --token-env TG_TOKEN`
  rm <name>                 disconnect a channel and delete its secrets
  pair <name>               get a one-time code; send /pair <code> to the bot to become owner
  help [command]            display help for command
```

```text
secrets (in an encrypted vault file; values are never shown)

Options:
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  ls                    list secret names (never values)
  keychain [on|off]     keep the vault key in the system keychain (on) or in ~/.beamhop/vault.key
                        (off, the default); without an argument, show where it is
  set [options] <name>  store a secret; reads the value from stdin, or --from-env
  rm <name>             delete a secret
  help [command]        display help for command
```

### beamhop secret ls

```text
Usage: beamhop secret ls [options]

list secret names (never values)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop secret keychain

```text
Usage: beamhop secret keychain [options] [on|off]

keep the vault key in the system keychain (on) or in ~/.beamhop/vault.key (off, the default);
without an argument, show where it is

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop secret set

```text
Usage: beamhop secret set [options] <name>

store a secret; reads the value from stdin, or --from-env

Options:
  --from-env <var>  read the value from this environment variable
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### beamhop secret rm

```text
Usage: beamhop secret rm [options] <name>

delete a secret

  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## beamhop schedule

```text
Usage: beamhop schedule [options] [command]

scheduled and event-driven prompts

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  ls [options]           list schedules
  add [options] <agent>  run a prompt on a cron, webhook, file change or Nostr event
  rm <id>                delete a schedule
  run <id>               run a schedule now
  help [command]         display help for command
```

### beamhop schedule ls

```text
Usage: beamhop schedule ls [options]

list schedules

Options:
  --agent <name>  only this agent
  -h, --help      display help for command
```

### beamhop schedule add

```text
Usage: beamhop schedule add [options] <agent>

run a prompt on a cron, webhook, file change or Nostr event

Options:
  --kind <kind>        trigger kind (choices: "cron", "webhook", "file-change", "nostr-event",
                       default: "cron")
  --spec <spec>        cron expression, webhook path, glob or nostr filter JSON
  --prompt <text>      what to send the agent
  --post-to <target>   channel target for the reply, e.g. mybot:group/-100123
  --tz <timezone>      IANA timezone (default: "UTC")
  --owner <principal>  whose role and budget applies
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

### beamhop schedule rm

```text
Usage: beamhop schedule rm [options] <id>

delete a schedule

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop schedule run

```text
Usage: beamhop schedule run [options] <id>

run a schedule now

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## beamhop deploy

```text
Usage: beamhop deploy [options] [command]

run agents in the cloud (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Fly.io, Render, Railway)

Options:
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  providers        list cloud providers and whether their API token is set
  plan [options]   show what a deploy would create and cost (changes nothing)
  apply [options]  create the cloud resources and move the agent
  ls               list deployments
  destroy <id>     tear down a deployment and its cloud resources
  help [command]   display help for command
```

### beamhop deploy providers

```text
Usage: beamhop deploy providers [options]

list cloud providers and whether their API token is set

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop deploy plan

```text
Usage: beamhop deploy plan [options]

show what a deploy would create and cost (changes nothing)

Options:
  --provider <id>  hetzner | digitalocean | fly | render | railway (see `deploy providers`)
  --agent <name>   agent to run in the cloud
  --region <id>    provider region
  --size <id>      provider machine size
  --mode <mode>    move the agent, or run a new copy (choices: "move", "new", default: "move")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### beamhop deploy apply

```text
Usage: beamhop deploy apply [options]

create the cloud resources and move the agent

Options:
  --provider <id>  hetzner | digitalocean | fly | render | railway (see `deploy providers`)
  --agent <name>   agent to run in the cloud
  --region <id>    provider region
  --size <id>      provider machine size
  --mode <mode>    move the agent, or run a new copy (choices: "move", "new", default: "move")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### beamhop deploy ls

```text
Usage: beamhop deploy ls [options]

list deployments

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## beamhop alerts

```text
Usage: beamhop alerts [options] [command]

alert thresholds (budget, security spikes, offline agents)

Options:
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  show            show the current alert rules
  set [options]   change alert rules, e.g. `beamhop alerts set --budget 80,100 --spike 5/10m
                  --heartbeat 15m`
  help [command]  display help for command
```

### beamhop alerts show

```text
Usage: beamhop alerts show [options]

show the current alert rules

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop alerts set

```text
Usage: beamhop alerts set [options]

change alert rules, e.g. `beamhop alerts set --budget 80,100 --spike 5/10m --heartbeat 15m`

Options:
  --budget <warn,alert>     warn and alert at these % of the daily budget
  --spike <events/minutes>  security spike: this many events within N minutes, e.g. 5/10m
  --heartbeat <minutes>     a cloud agent is offline after this long without a heartbeat, e.g. 15m
  --nostr-dm                also DM owners on their channels
  --no-nostr-dm             alerts only as push / in the app
  -h, --help                display help for command
```

## beamhop audit

```text
Usage: beamhop audit [options]

every decision, violation and config change, newest first

Options:
  --agent <name>  only this agent
  --severity <s>  only this severity (choices: "info", "warn", "security")
  --limit <n>     max events (default: 50)
  -h, --help      display help for command
```

```text
  -h, --help      display help for command
```

## beamhop device

```text
Usage: beamhop device [options] [command]

paired devices (phones, browsers)

Options:
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  ls                             list paired devices
  pair [options]                 pair a phone: QR code for the hosted app, then confirm the safety
                                 phrase here
  confirm [options] <pairingId>  show the safety phrase of a pending pairing; --accept if it matches
                                 the phone, else --reject
  rm <id>                        unpair a device
  help [command]                 display help for command
```

### beamhop device ls

```text
Usage: beamhop device ls [options]

list paired devices

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop device pair

```text
Usage: beamhop device pair [options]

pair a phone: QR code for the hosted app, then confirm the safety phrase here

Options:
  --name <name>        device name (default: "New device")
  --no-wait            print the QR / link and exit (confirm later with `beamhop device confirm`)
  --timeout <seconds>  how long to wait for the phone (default: 120)
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

### beamhop device confirm

```text
Usage: beamhop device confirm [options] <pairingId>

show the safety phrase of a pending pairing; --accept if it matches the phone, else --reject

Options:
  --accept    the phrase matches the one on the phone: pair it
  --reject    the phrase does not match: cancel the pairing
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

### beamhop device rm

```text
Usage: beamhop device rm [options] <id>

unpair a device

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## beamhop data

```text
Usage: beamhop data [options] [command]

export or purge transcripts and audit data

Options:
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  export [options]  export transcripts and audit data to a file
  purge [options]   delete transcripts and usage data (the audit log too with --audit)
  help [command]    display help for command
```

### beamhop data export

```text
Usage: beamhop data export [options]

export transcripts and audit data to a file

Options:
  --agent <name>  only this agent
  -h, --help      display help for command
```

### beamhop data purge

```text
Usage: beamhop data purge [options]

delete transcripts and usage data (the audit log too with --audit)

Options:
  --agent <name>      only this agent
  --before <isoDate>  only records older than this date
  --audit             also delete audit entries
  -y, --yes           confirm deleting everything (needed without --agent or --before)
  -h, --help          display help for command
```
